metadata.description: Knowledge-base skill families built on the LLM-as-librarian pattern.

plugins.name: ai-lib
plugins.description: An Agentic RAG document library over your own PDFs — AI, LLM, data science, math/science/tech/cyber and miscellaneous. Fourteen leaf topics, one subagent per topic. Every claim carries a page locator or says why it does not; links are followed exactly one hop and the limit is audited by the linter; benchmark comparison and disagreement detection are deterministic Python.
